item.description:
And then they throw in some Celtic languages and yoink bits of languages from around the world along the way. The result: a language where there are usually about 10 different ways to say something, but when it comes to writing, you sit at your desk for 20 minutes trying to think of one 🤣
#amwriting

item.author: Nicholas Allen (@dedalusdenaries.bsky.social)
item.description: I met a man earlier who told me when he was young his gran would send him to the library in town to pick two books for her (Mills & Boon) and two for him, and when he came home she had dinner made and then they read together, each in an armchair. A lovely gift I thought, from a foresightful woman.
